integrity: The Reynolds equations are reconstructed directly from the Lie bracket and split into three disjoint field-level branches. The counting and rank formulas are proved for arbitrary finite fields and replayed by exhaustive enumeration over four prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The enumeration is specific to the two-dimensional affine Lie algebra.
The zeta statement concerns the reduced field-valued solution set and does not assert scheme-theoretic reducedness in every characteristic.
title: Reynolds operators on the two-dimensional affine Lie algebra over finite fields
